interface.signature: def isMatch(s: str, p: str) -> bool

preconditions.description: The input string s must be a string.
The pattern p must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must contain only lowercase letters a-z.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: The pattern p must contain only lowercase letters a-z, and characters ? or *.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (s == p or (p == '*' and s == '') or (p.startswith('*') and isMatch(s, p[1:])) or (p.endswith('*') and isMatch(s[:-1], p[:-1])) or (p and s and (p[0] in {s[0], '?'} and isMatch(s[1:], p[1:])))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if the pattern p matches the entire input string s, considering '?' as any single character and '*' as any sequence of characters (including the empty sequence).
